user.title: Awesome Theme Collection
user.description: Installs and manages the Awesome themes for Home Assistant.

areas.title: Awesome Theme Collection
areas.description: Enable or disable the desired theme areas. Disabling an area removes its associated themes and wallpapers managed by this integration.

metal.title: Awesome-Metal-Themes
metal.description: Configure Metal themes, background images, background colors and section styling.

themes.name: Select
themes.description: Select the Metal themes to install.

backgrounds.name: Backgrounds
backgrounds.description: Select dashboard and popup background images and their colors for the Metal themes. Colors can be specified as a linear-gradient.

sections.name: Section spacing and border color
sections.description: These settings apply exclusively to Metal themes.

data.section_border_color_metal: Border color (when a section background is active)

sections.name: Section spacing and border color
